  4. Add the egg and green onions.
  5. Serve the ramen immediately.

    const form = document.getElementById('regForm');
    const idInput = document.getElementById('studentId');
    const nameInput = document.getElementById('fullName');
    const trackInput = document.getElementById('track');
    const emailInput = document.getElementById('email');
    const passwordInput = document.getElementById('password');
    const confirmInput = document.getElementById('confirmPassword');
    const termsInput = document.getElementById('agreeTerms');
    const formContainer = document.getElementById('formContainer');
    const successCard = document.getElementById('successCard');
    const summaryDetails = document.getElementById('summaryDetails');
    const touchedFields = new Set();

    function markValid(input, errorId) {
      input.classList.remove('is-invalid');
      input.classList.add('is-valid');
      input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'false');
      document.getElementById(errorId).textContent = '';
      return true;
    }

    function markInvalid(input, errorId, message) {
      input.classList.remove('is-valid');
      input.classList.add('is-invalid');
      input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
      document.getElementById(errorId).textContent = message;
      return false;
    }

    function checkId() {
      const value = idInput.value.trim();
      if (!value) return markInvalid(idInput, 'idError', 'Enter your campus ID.');
      if (!/^\d{9}$/.test(value)) return markInvalid(idInput, 'idError', 'Your campus ID must be exactly 9 digits.');
      return markValid(idInput, 'idError');
    }

    function checkName() {
      const value = nameInput.value.trim();
      if (!value) return markInvalid(nameInput, 'nameError', 'Tell us your name.');
      if (value.length < 2) return markInvalid(nameInput, 'nameError', 'Your name must be at least 2 characters.');
      return markValid(nameInput, 'nameError');
    }

    function checkTrack() {
      if (!trackInput.value) return markInvalid(trackInput, 'trackError', 'Choose the lab track you’re interested in.');
      return markValid(trackInput, 'trackError');
    }

    function checkEmail() {
      const value = emailInput.value.trim();
      if (!value) return markInvalid(emailInput, 'emailError', 'Enter your email address.');
      if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value)) {
        return markInvalid(emailInput, 'emailError', 'Enter a valid email address, like you@example.edu.');
      }
      return markValid(emailInput, 'emailError');
    }

    function checkPassword() {
      if (!passwordInput.value) return markInvalid(passwordInput, 'passwordError', 'Create a password to continue.');
      if (passwordInput.value.length < 8) {
        return markInvalid(passwordInput, 'passwordError', 'Use at least 8 characters for your password.');
      }
      markValid(passwordInput, 'passwordError');
      if (touchedFields.has(confirmInput)) checkConfirm();
      return true;
    }

    function checkConfirm() {
      if (!confirmInput.value) return markInvalid(confirmInput, 'confirmError', 'Type your password one more time.');
      if (confirmInput.value !== passwordInput.value) {
        return markInvalid(confirmInput, 'confirmError', 'These passwords don’t match yet.');
      }
      return markValid(confirmInput, 'confirmError');
    }

    function checkTerms() {
      const error = document.getElementById('termsError');
      if (!termsInput.checked) {
        termsInput.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
        error.textContent = 'Please agree to the participation guidelines to register.';
        return false;
      }
      termsInput.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'false');
      error.textContent = '';
      return true;
    }

    const fieldChecks = new Map([
      [idInput, checkId],
      [nameInput, checkName],
      [trackInput, checkTrack],
      [emailInput, checkEmail],
      [passwordInput, checkPassword],
      [confirmInput, checkConfirm]
    ]);

    for (const [input, check] of fieldChecks) {
      input.addEventListener('blur', () => {
        touchedFields.add(input);
        check();
      });
      input.addEventListener(input === trackInput ? 'change' : 'input', () => {
        if (touchedFields.has(input)) check();
      });
    }

    termsInput.addEventListener('change', checkTerms);

    form.addEventListener('submit', (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      for (const input of fieldChecks.keys()) touchedFields.add(input);

      const checks = [...fieldChecks.values()].map((check) => check());
      const termsValid = checkTerms();
      const valid = checks.every(Boolean) && termsValid;
      if (!valid) {
        const firstInvalid = form.querySelector('[aria-invalid="true"]');
        firstInvalid?.focus();
        return;
      }

      const details = [
        ['Campus ID', idInput.value.trim()],
        ['Name', nameInput.value.trim()],
        ['Lab track', trackInput.value],
        ['Email', emailInput.value.trim()]
      ];
      summaryDetails.replaceChildren(...details.map(([label, value]) => {
        const row = document.createElement('div');
        row.className = 'summary-row';
        const term = document.createElement('dt');
        term.textContent = label;
        const description = document.createElement('dd');
        description.textContent = value;
        row.append(term, description);
        return row;
      }));

      formContainer.hidden = true;
      successCard.hidden = false;
      successCard.focus();
    });

    document.getElementById('resetButton').addEventListener('click', () => {
      form.reset();
      touchedFields.clear();
      for (const input of [...fieldChecks.keys(), termsInput]) {
        input.classList.remove('is-valid', 'is-invalid');
        input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'false');
      }
      for (const error of form.querySelectorAll('.error-msg')) error.textContent = '';
      summaryDetails.replaceChildren();
      successCard.hidden = true;
      formContainer.hidden = false;
      idInput.focus();
    });
  </script>
</body>

    <header class="lesson-heading">

      <h1>Make every click <span>count.</span></h1>
      <p>Use a real button, give icon-only controls a name, and make the keyboard focus easy to spot.</p>
    </header>

    <section class="demo-card" aria-labelledby="demo-heading">
      <p class="demo-kicker">Try it yourself</p>
      <h2 id="demo-heading">A small, keyboard-friendly preview</h2>
      <p class="demo-copy">Press Tab to reach each control. Activate the green button with Enter or Space, then try closing the preview.</p>

        <div class="preview-bar" aria-hidden="true">
          <span class="preview-dot"></span><span class="preview-dot"></span><span class="preview-dot"></span>

          <div class="preview-actions">
            <button type="button" class="primary-action" id="publishButton">Publish preview <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></button>
            <button type="button" class="icon-action" id="closeButton" aria-label="Close preview">✕</button>

        </div>
      </div>
      <p class="activation-result" id="activationResult" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>

          <strong>Why this works</strong>
          <p>Real <code><button></code> elements are keyboard-operable by default. The close button’s accessible name explains its purpose, and both controls get a visible focus ring.</p>
        </div>
      </aside>

    const publishButton = document.getElementById('publishButton');
    const closeButton = document.getElementById('closeButton');
    const previewContent = document.querySelector('.preview-content');
    const result = document.getElementById('activationResult');

    publishButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (previewContent.hidden) {
        previewContent.hidden = false;
        result.textContent = 'Preview reopened. You can try closing it again.';
        return;
      }
      result.textContent = 'Preview published! This button works with a mouse or keyboard.';
    });

      previewContent.hidden = true;
      result.textContent = 'Preview closed. Focus has returned to the publish button.';
      publishButton.focus();
    });
  </script>

<body>
  <main class="lesson-page">
    <a class="back" href="../index.html">Back to Week 9</a>
    <header class="lesson-heading">
      <p class="eyebrow">Lab 02 · Image descriptions</p>
      <h1>Give every image <span>a purpose.</span></h1>
      <p>Informative images need useful descriptions. Decorative images need empty alt text. A linked logo should explain where it goes.</p>
    </header>

    <section class="demo-card" aria-labelledby="image-lab-heading">
      <p class="demo-kicker">Four images · Four decisions</p>
      <h2 id="image-lab-heading">What should a screen reader hear?</h2>
      <div class="image-grid">
        <article class="image-example">
          <figure>
            <div class="image-frame">
              <img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="Gachon University campus building among trees and walking paths">
            </div>
            <figcaption><strong>Campus photograph</strong>Informative — describe the detail that matters.</figcaption>
          </figure>
        </article>
        <article class="image-example">
          <figure>
            <div class="image-frame wave-frame">
              <img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="" data-decorative="true">
            </div>
            <figcaption><strong>Decorative divider</strong>Decorative — <code>alt=""</code> keeps extra noise out.</figcaption>
          </figure>
        </article>
        <article class="image-example">
          <figure>
            <div class="image-frame logo-frame">
              <a href="../index.html">
                <img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="All weeks - Week 9 accessibility lab">
              </a>
            </div>
            <figcaption><strong>Linked logo</strong>The alt text gives the link a useful accessible name.</figcaption>
          </figure>
        </article>
        <article class="image-example">
          <figure>
            <div class="image-frame chart-frame">
              <img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="Student enrollment increased from 1,200 in 2024 to 1,400 in 2025 and 1,476 in 2026">
            </div>
            <figcaption><strong>Enrollment chart</strong>Summarize the trend and key values in the alternative text.</figcaption>
          </figure>
        </article>
      </div>

      <div class="alt-check">
        <p>Run a quick check for missing, generic, or misplaced alternative text.</p>
        <button type="button" class="alt-check-button" id="checkAlts">Check these descriptions</button>
      </div>
      <div id="altResults" class="alt-results" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"></div>
    </section>
  </main>
  <script>
    const checkAltsButton = document.getElementById('checkAlts');
    const altResults = document.getElementById('altResults');
    const genericDescriptions = new Set(['image', 'photo', 'logo', 'chart', 'picture']);

    checkAltsButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const images = document.querySelectorAll('.image-example img');
      const list = document.createElement('ul');

      images.forEach((image, index) => {
        const label = image.closest('.image-example').querySelector('figcaption strong').textContent;
        const alt = image.getAttribute('alt');
        let message;
        let hasError = false;

        if (alt === null) {
          message = 'missing the alt attribute.';
          hasError = true;
        } else if (image.closest('figure').querySelector('a') && alt.trim() === '') {
          message = 'the linked image needs text to name its link.';
          hasError = true;
        } else if (image.dataset.decorative === 'true' && alt !== '') {
          message = 'is decorative, so its alt text should be empty.';
          hasError = true;
        } else if (image.dataset.decorative === 'true') {
          message = 'correctly uses empty alt text because it is decorative.';
        } else if (alt.trim() === '') {
          message = 'is informative, so it needs a useful description.';
          hasError = true;
        } else if (genericDescriptions.has(alt.trim().toLowerCase())) {
          message = 'uses a generic description. Describe what matters instead.';
          hasError = true;
        } else {
          message = `has a description: “${alt}”.`;
        }

        const item = document.createElement('li');
        item.dataset.status = hasError ? 'error' : 'pass';
        const status = document.createElement('strong');
        status.textContent = hasError ? 'CHECK' : 'PASS';
        const details = document.createElement('span');
        details.textContent = `Image ${index + 1} · ${label}: ${message}`;
        item.append(status, details);
        list.append(item);
      });

      altResults.replaceChildren(list);
    });
  </script>
</body>

    <a class="back" href="../index.html">Back to Week 9</a>
    <header class="lesson-heading">
      <p class="eyebrow">Lab 03 · Accessible forms</p>
      <h1>A signup that feels <span>clear.</span></h1>
      <p>Give every field a real label, connect helpful instructions, and explain errors with words—not color alone.</p>
    </header>

    <section class="signup-layout" aria-label="Accessible account creation demo">
      <aside class="signup-aside">
        <div>
          <span class="signup-mark" aria-hidden="true">✦</span>
          <h2>Make room for good ideas.</h2>
        </div>
        <p>Thoughtful details make it easier for everyone to join in.</p>
      </aside>

      <div class="signup-main">
        <div class="signup-top">
          <div>
            <p class="eyebrow">Your next chapter</p>
            <h2>Create your account</h2>
          </div>
          <button type="button" class="icon-button" id="searchButton" aria-label="Search help">⌕</button>
        </div>
        <p id="searchFeedback" class="search-feedback" role="status" hidden>Need a hand? Start with the labeled fields below.</p>
        <p class="signup-intro">Just two details to get started. This demo keeps everything in your browser.</p>

        <form id="signupForm" novalidate>
          <div class="signup-field">
            <label for="email">Email address</label>
            <input type="email" id="email" name="email" autocomplete="email" placeholder="you@example.com" aria-describedby="emailHint emailError" aria-invalid="false" required>
            <p class="signup-hint" id="emailHint">We’ll use this as your account sign-in.</p>
            <p class="signup-error" id="emailError" aria-live="polite"></p>
          </div>

          <div class="signup-field">
            <label for="password">Create a password</label>
            <input type="password" id="password" name="password" autocomplete="new-password" placeholder="At least 8 characters" aria-describedby="passwordHint passwordError" aria-invalid="false" minlength="8" required>
            <p class="signup-hint" id="passwordHint">Use at least 8 characters.</p>
            <p class="signup-error" id="passwordError" aria-live="polite"></p>
          </div>

          <button type="submit" class="signup-submit">Create account <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></button>
          <p class="signup-result" id="signupResult" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
        </form>

        <a class="signup-logo-link" href="../index.html">
          <img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="All weeks - Week 9 accessibility lab">
        </a>
      </div>
    </section>

    <aside class="takeaway">
      <span class="takeaway-mark" aria-hidden="true">✓</span>
      <div>
        <strong>Accessible by design</strong>
        <p>Each label is connected to its field, instructions and errors are announced, and validation tells you what to fix.</p>
      </div>
    </aside>
  </main>
  <script>
    const signupForm = document.getElementById('signupForm');
    const emailInput = document.getElementById('email');
    const passwordInput = document.getElementById('password');
    const signupResult = document.getElementById('signupResult');
    const touchedFields = new Set();
    const fieldChecks = [
      {
        input: emailInput,
        error: document.getElementById('emailError'),
        validate() {
          if (!emailInput.value.trim()) return 'Enter your email address.';
          if (emailInput.validity.typeMismatch) return 'Enter a valid email address, like you@example.com.';
          return '';
        }
      },
      {
        input: passwordInput,
        error: document.getElementById('passwordError'),
        validate() {
          if (!passwordInput.value) return 'Create a password to continue.';
          if (passwordInput.value.length < 8) return 'Use at least 8 characters for your password.';
          return '';
        }
      }
    ];

    function validateField(field) {
      const message = field.validate();
      field.input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', String(Boolean(message)));
      field.error.textContent = message;
      return !message;
    }

    fieldChecks.forEach((field) => {
      field.input.addEventListener('blur', () => {
        touchedFields.add(field.input);
        validateField(field);
      });
      field.input.addEventListener('input', () => {
        signupResult.textContent = '';
        if (touchedFields.has(field.input)) validateField(field);
      });
    });

    signupForm.addEventListener('submit', (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      fieldChecks.forEach(({ input }) => touchedFields.add(input));
      const isValid = fieldChecks.map(validateField).every(Boolean);

      if (!isValid) {
        signupForm.querySelector('[aria-invalid="true"]').focus();
        signupResult.textContent = 'Check the highlighted fields and try again.';
        return;
      }

      signupResult.textContent = `Your demo account is ready for ${emailInput.value.trim()}. Your password stays private.`;
    });

    document.getElementById('searchButton').addEventListener('click', () => {
      document.getElementById('searchFeedback').hidden = false;
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
